en: The Apadāna of the Elder Phaladāyaka Timira Chapter, Number 7 I gave a single fruit to the Buddha, the peerless one, the Teacher who brings benefit to the world. Because of that deed, I have been reborn in heaven for eighty-four thousand aeons. Thereafter, having passed through many hundreds of thousands of births, I was born here in the human realm. Having abandoned all defilements, I have attained final Nibbāna. This is the fruit of giving a single fruit. One should always give alms to the Buddhas. With fruit in hand, I gave a fruit.
This fruit that I gave with a mind full of serene confidence—
When a new existence was being produced,
The fruit that I gave away—
I do not know a state of woe;
this is the fruit of the gift of fruit.
[and so on] ...the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed the venerable elder Phaladāyaka spoke these verses.
This is the seventh legend of the elder Phaladāyaka.
